sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 10214609, fetched 2026-10-20)

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214609 ('Mitchell Landing Campground is open August 15-April 15'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214609 ('a primitive campground', 'There is no water available') + RIDB catalog (every site typed NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 12 campsites on gravel or grass pads: 9 standard sites for tents, RVs and travel trailers and 3 tent-only. The catalog gives a vehicle length (14 ft) for only two sites, so no maximum is recorded. Access is a secondary gravel road; the east entrance to Loop Road is the easier one for larger vehicles.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214609 ('offers 12 campsites', 'Campsites have gravel or grass pads and accommodate tent and RV campers', 'The east entrance to Loop Road will offer easier access to larger vehicles') + RIDB catalog (9 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, 3 TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC; Max Vehicle Length 14 on sites 8 and 10 only), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Picnic tables, fire rings and shared food storage; no drinking water. Generators off at 10 pm.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214609 ('This campground offers vault toilets, picnic tables, shared food storage, and fire rings. There is no water available.'; notice 'All generators must be off at 10:00 pm'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve and pay online on recreation.gov ('Payments must be made online'); cell coverage at the campground is limited to none, so book ahead. One site (9) is not reservable in the catalog.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214609 ('Cell phone service is limited and it is highly encouraged that reservations be made in advance'; notice 'Payments must be made online. There is limited to no cell phone coverage at the campground, advance reservations are highly recommended.') + RIDB catalog (site 9 reservable: false, the other 11 true), read 2026-10-21

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214609/rates (Peak Season 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-01 and 2026-08-15 to 2026-12-31: PeakStandardNonelectric 24), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov: $24/night (2026), no electric or water, reservable on recreation.gov. Added season August 15 - April 15, 12 sites (9 standard, 3 tent-only), vault toilets, no drinking water, one non-reservable site. AWH note kept. Not stated: max rig length (catalog gives 14 ft on only two sites), stay limits, booking window.
flags: Missing phone: recreation.gov gives (239) 631-9988 for facility-specific information (facility phone 239-695-1117 is the preserve's ORV office line).

Site lengths: the RIDB catalog gives Max Vehicle Length 14 ft on the two sites that list one (8 and 10); the others list none. The description says sites 'accommodate tent and RV campers' and allow travel trailers, so 23-ft fit is not shown either way.
Ownership is NPS (Big Cypress National Preserve), not USFS Apalachicola NF as the batch brief described; entry's 'federal' is right. No storm closure notice on recreation.gov as of 2026-10-21.
